title: Events and a stream of lines
hints: Stock: keep a Map of quantities in a private field. this.emit("changed", { name, quantity: total }) announces a change.
splitLines: keep the unfinished tail: const parts = (rest + chunk).split("\n"); rest = parts.pop(); yield* parts; and yield rest at the end when it is not empty.
summarize: for await (const line of splitLines(source)), skip blank lines, split on whitespace, and compare Number(ms) with the longest so far.
